finalists.label: Myotonic Dystrophy
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including giant motor unit potential and neuropathic changes, and fatty infiltration, mild fiber size variation, whorled fibers, and internalized nuclei.

finalists.label: Muscular Dystrophy
finalists.why: It has a broad range of findings, including very low birth weight, progressive muscle weakness, and giant motor unit potential, with no significant evidence against it.

finalists.label: Pompe Disease
finalists.why: Although it has normal acid alpha-glucosidase activity against it, the mildly elevated plasma creatine kinase is a specific finding for this candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive findings, including giant motor unit potential and neuropathic changes, and fatty infiltration, mild fiber size variation, whorled fibers, and internalized nuclei, which are not fully explained by the runner-up.
